text_block_list.text: One day, Mejiro Ryan brought me along to a strangely deserted island.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Look,
at that towering rock face over there...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This island is actually famous in certain circles
as a natural rock climbing spot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes! Well then, I'm off! Please wait for me at the summit, Trainer!

Watching Mejiro Ryan head toward the rock wall,
I decided to climb the slope leading up to the summit.

Mejiro Ryan pushed upward with everything she had,
and at last, the finish line was just ahead.
However, her stamina was already near its limit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... ngh.
Just a little bit more to the summit, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've made it this far!
I'm definitely reaching that finish line!!" his far!
I'm definitely crossing that finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~~!!
Even the exhaustion feels good right now...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Thank you so much for reaching out your hand to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My shoulders, arms, back, and legs—
it feels like every muscle in my body has grown stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right now, I feel like I could pull off any kind of running style...! Heheh!!

Having overcome the grueling rock climb,
Mejiro Ryan seems to have grown even stronger.
